question.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x) = P(X \leq x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(7) & =P(X\le 7) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,…,7\}) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,…,6\})+P(X=7) \\  & =P(X\le 6)+P(X=7) \\  & =F(6)+P(X=7).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=7) & =F(7)-F(6) \\  & =0.7440-0.6063 \\  & =0.1377.\end{aligned}
$$
